transitions.name: Define Business Needs
transitions.guard: The business strategy and goals are available and the needs and questions worth exploring are recorded.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Define Strategy and Standards
transitions.to: Defined Big Data Strategy and Standards
transitions.guard: The strategy, standards and sourcing plan are drafted within the enterprise data architecture in force and the IT standards.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Strategy and Standards
transitions.from: Defined Big Data Strategy and Standards
transitions.guard: The DM managers and business executives approve the strategy, standards and sourcing plan.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Return Strategy for Rework
transitions.from: Defined Big Data Strategy and Standards
transitions.guard: The strategy is rejected with recorded reasons.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Bring Standards into Force
transitions.guard: The strategy and standards are published and the data usage metrics defined.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Open Strategy Review
transitions.guard: Learnings, a business change or a standards change trigger a review; the standards in force are retained meanwhile.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Reviewed Strategy
transitions.guard: The reviewed strategy and standards are approved and published.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Strategy
transitions.guard: No platform is in service and the retirement is recorded.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Decide Platform
transitions.guard: The build, buy or rent decision is made under the decision tree and the IT standards.

transitions.name: Provision Platform
transitions.guard: The platform is provisioned in an environment in service and its loading and scanning metrics baselined.

transitions.name: Accept Platform into Service
transitions.guard: Acceptance passes and monitoring of response, performance, loading and scanning metrics is active.

transitions.name: Return Platform for Rework
transitions.guard: Acceptance fails with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Open Scaling
transitions.guard: A capacity or performance breach is detected; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Complete Scaling
transitions.guard: Scaling returns the platform within its targets.

transitions.name: Decommission Platform
transitions.guard: All sources on the platform are retired or migrated and the decommission recorded.

transitions.name: Decommission Platform under Scaling
transitions.guard: A platform that cannot be scaled to target is replaced; sources migrated or retired first.

transitions.name: Re-provision Platform
transitions.guard: A decommissioned platform is needed again and its decision re-made.

transitions.name: Choose Source
transitions.guard: The source is assessed under the sourcing plan for value, cost, quality, privacy basis and licence, and chosen.

transitions.name: Acquire Source
transitions.guard: The agreement or licence is in place and delivery arranged with the producer or supplier.

transitions.name: Reject Source
transitions.guard: The assessment fails or the acquisition is declined with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Ingest Source
transitions.guard: The source is ingested into a platform in service over an exchange in operation; loading and scanning metrics recorded.

transitions.name: Align Source
transitions.guard: The source is integrated and aligned for analysis with its metadata and lineage recorded.

transitions.name: Raise Source Alert
transitions.guard: A schema change, delivery failure or quality drift is detected; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Realign Source
transitions.guard: The cause is resolved and the source realigned.

transitions.name: Retire Source
transitions.guard: No model depends on the source; its agreement is closed and lineage retained.

transitions.name: Retire Source on Alert
transitions.guard: An unresolved alert leads to withdrawal of the source; no model depends on it.

transitions.name: Re-choose Source
transitions.guard: A retired source is needed again and reassessed under the sourcing plan.

transitions.name: Refresh Ingestion
transitions.guard: A new delivery is ingested; alignment is redone on the new data.

transitions.name: Develop Hypothesis
transitions.guard: A hypothesis and its methods are developed from a defined business need.

transitions.name: Explore Data
transitions.guard: The model is explored on aligned sources and the initial analysis recorded.

transitions.name: Validate Model
transitions.guard: Holdout, method, bias and fitness checks pass on sources with conforming quality.

transitions.name: Revise Hypothesis
transitions.guard: Exploration or validation does not support the hypothesis; it is revised.

transitions.name: Deploy Model
transitions.guard: The validated model is deployed on a platform in service within the privacy basis of its sources and monitoring is active.

transitions.name: Raise Drift Alert
transitions.guard: Monitoring flags drift or a performance breach; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Resolve Drift Alert
transitions.guard: The cause is resolved (retrained within tolerance) and the model verified.

transitions.name: Open Enhancement
transitions.guard: An enhancement plan opens a new version; the deployed version stays in use.

transitions.name: Open Enhancement on Alert
transitions.guard: A drift alert is answered by an enhancement; the deployed version stays in use.

transitions.name: Deploy Enhanced Model
transitions.guard: The enhanced version is validated and deployed; it supersedes the previous version, whose insights are superseded or redrafted.

transitions.name: Retire Model
transitions.guard: The model is withdrawn from use with its insights superseded or withdrawn; learnings retained.

transitions.name: Retire Model on Alert
transitions.guard: An unresolved drift alert leads to withdrawal; insights superseded or withdrawn.

transitions.name: Abandon Model
transitions.guard: An explored model is not pursued; the learnings are retained.

transitions.name: Redevelop Model
transitions.guard: A retired model is needed again and its hypothesis redeveloped.

transitions.name: Draft Insight
transitions.guard: A finding is drafted from an explored, validated or deployed model with its visualization.

transitions.name: Review Insight
transitions.guard: The trust and ethics review passes: appropriate, trusted, ethical, privacy respected.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Reject Insight
transitions.guard: The trust and ethics review fails; the draft is withdrawn with the reason recorded.
transitions.holder: Big Data and Data Science Practice Manager

transitions.name: Publish Insight
transitions.guard: The reviewed insight is published using visualization techniques under the standards in force.

transitions.name: Supersede Insight
transitions.guard: A newer finding replaces the insight; the earlier version is retained.

transitions.name: Withdraw Insight
transitions.guard: The insight is withdrawn for a trust, ethics, accuracy or privacy reason.

transitions.name: Redraft Superseded Insight
transitions.guard: A superseded insight is redrafted from the current model.

transitions.name: Redraft Withdrawn Insight
transitions.guard: A withdrawn insight is redrafted with the reason addressed.

transitions.name: Evaluate Existing Specifications
transitions.guard: The Enterprise Architecture, Business Architecture, IT standards and data strategies are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Design Architecture
transitions.guard: The architecture design, data flows, value chains and standards are drafted to the diagramming clarity standard.

transitions.name: Approve Architecture
transitions.guard: The blueprint is approved and its standards approved as governing instruments under Data Governance.

transitions.name: Return Design for Rework
transitions.guard: The design is rejected with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Bring Architecture into Force
transitions.guard: The blueprint is integrated with the Enterprise Architecture and published for use.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Open Revision
transitions.guard: A business, technology or Enterprise Architecture trigger is recorded; the blueprint in force is retained meanwhile and affected assets identified.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Architecture
transitions.guard: The revised blueprint is approved and integrated; affected assets are flagged for reassessment.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Retire Architecture
transitions.guard: The blueprint is retired without replacement and the retirement recorded.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Scope Model
transitions.guard: Subject areas are scoped from the data strategies and the evaluated specifications.

transitions.name: Approve Model Version
transitions.guard: The model version is approved under the architecture standards.

transitions.name: Return Model for Rework
transitions.guard: The model version is rejected with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Publish Model Version
transitions.guard: The approved version is published through the metadata stores as the current model.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Approve New Version
transitions.guard: A new version is approved from enterprise requirements managed within projects; the current version stays published.

transitions.name: Supersede Published Version
transitions.guard: The new version is published and the previous version retained; assets in changed subject areas are flagged for reassessment.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Withdraw Model
transitions.guard: The model is withdrawn with the architecture and no placed asset remains.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-05 Enterprise Architecture Integration and Publication

transitions.name: Plan Roadmap
transitions.guard: The roadmap is drafted from the architecture gaps and sequenced.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Approve Roadmap
transitions.guard: The roadmap is approved with its sequence and funding.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Return Roadmap for Rework
transitions.guard: The roadmap is rejected with recorded reasons.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Start Execution
transitions.guard: Roadmap projects start with their enterprise data requirements assigned.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Deliver Roadmap
transitions.guard: The roadmap's projects are delivered and business value measured.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Re-plan Roadmap
transitions.guard: A scope, priority or architecture change requires re-planning; running projects continue.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Approve Re-planned Roadmap
transitions.guard: The re-planned roadmap is approved.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Plan Next Roadmap
transitions.guard: The next roadmap cycle is drafted from outstanding items and new gaps.
mechanisms: CTRL-DA-04 Roadmap Planning and Execution Tracking

transitions.name: Place Asset
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The asset is placed in a subject area of the published model and in the data flows of the blueprint in force.

transitions.name: Confirm Conformance
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A lifecycle review confirms conformance to the standards in force.

transitions.name: Find Deviation
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A lifecycle review finds a deviation; a Data Asset issue is logged with Data Governance.

transitions.name: Grant Exception
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A dated exception with a remediation plan is approved for the deviation.

transitions.name: Remediate to Conformance
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The deviation is remediated and a lifecycle review confirms conformance.

transitions.name: Expire Exception
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The exception reaches its expiry without remediation.

transitions.name: Close Exception by Remediation
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The remediation plan is completed and a lifecycle review confirms conformance.

transitions.name: Flag for Reassessment
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A blueprint or model revision affects the asset's subject area, flows or standards.

transitions.name: Flag Exception for Reassessment
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A blueprint or model revision affects the asset under exception.

transitions.name: Reassess as Conforming
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The new lifecycle review confirms conformance to the revised blueprint.

transitions.name: Reassess as Deviating
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The new lifecycle review finds a deviation against the revised blueprint; a Data Asset issue is logged.

transitions.name: Remove Placement
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The asset is disposed or descoped and its placement removed from the model and flows.

transitions.name: Remove Non-conforming Placement
transitions.region: Architectural Conformance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The non-conforming asset is disposed or descoped and its placement removed; the DG issue is closed.

transitions.name: Formulate Strategy
transitions.guard: A sponsor and scope exist; business and IT strategies and goals are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Strategy
transitions.guard: Strategy, data strategy and roadmap are aligned to business goals and readiness findings.

transitions.name: Start Roadmap Execution
transitions.guard: Roadmap and implementation strategy exist; projects are underwritten.

transitions.name: Evidence Value
transitions.guard: Data asset valuation is sponsored and recognised value is reported.

transitions.name: Revise Strategy after Execution
transitions.guard: A material change in business or regulatory direction is recorded.

transitions.name: Revise Strategy after Value
transitions.guard: A material change in business or regulatory direction is recorded.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Strategy
transitions.guard: The revised strategy and roadmap are approved.

transitions.name: Withdraw Strategy
transitions.guard: The strategy is withdrawn without replacement and the withdrawal is recorded.

transitions.name: Design Operating Model
transitions.guard: A design mandate exists; organisational touchpoints are being identified.

transitions.name: Approve Operating Model
transitions.guard: The operating framework and federation model are approved.

transitions.name: Assign Roles
transitions.guard: Data Owners, Data Stewards and governance bodies are assigned for the governed scope.

transitions.name: Activate Operations Plan
transitions.guard: The operations plan is approved and governance bodies are meeting.

transitions.name: Restructure Operating Model
transitions.guard: A restructuring trigger is recorded; roles in force are retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Operating Model
transitions.guard: The revised model is approved and roles reassigned where changed.

transitions.name: Record Role Vacancy
transitions.guard: An owner, steward or body role required for the scope is vacant.

transitions.name: Initiate Readiness Assessment
transitions.guard: Assessment scope, assessors and criteria are defined.

transitions.name: Establish Readiness Baseline
transitions.guard: Maturity level, culture findings and gaps are accepted by the sponsor.

transitions.name: Launch Change Programme
transitions.guard: Change objectives, communications plan and sponsors are authorised.

transitions.name: Confirm Target Readiness
transitions.guard: Reassessment shows the target maturity and culture indicators are reached.

transitions.name: Reassess Readiness
transitions.guard: The reassessment interval has elapsed or a lapse is detected.

transitions.name: Reassess during Change
transitions.guard: A scheduled interim reassessment is due.

transitions.name: Develop Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: Regulatory requirements and organisation policies are assessed as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: Principles, policies, procedures, standards and reference architecture are approved.

transitions.name: Publish Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: Instruments are communicated and compliance monitoring is in place.

transitions.name: Review Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: A regulatory, strategic or compliance trigger is recorded.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: Revised instruments are approved.

transitions.name: Retire Instruments
transitions.region: Principles, Policies, Procedures and Business Reference Architecture
transitions.guard: All instruments for the scope are retired without replacement.

transitions.name: Log Issue
transitions.guard: An issue against the Data Asset is logged with its source Knowledge Area, severity and owner; a transition refused by a Non-waivable or Required guard raises one automatically, carrying the requested transition, the requesting activity and role, the decision right and every guard that answered false (Howard, 23 Sep 2026).

transitions.name: Assign Resolution
transitions.guard: A steward is assigned under the operating model and a plan exists.

transitions.name: Escalate Issue
transitions.guard: Resolution is blocked or exceeds tolerance; escalation authority is engaged.

transitions.name: Escalate Open Issue
transitions.guard: Severity requires immediate escalation.

transitions.name: Resolve Issue
transitions.guard: Resolution evidence is accepted by the issue owner.

transitions.name: Decide Escalated Issue
transitions.guard: The governance body resolves the issue or accepts the residual risk.

transitions.name: Close Issue
transitions.guard: Closure evidence is retained.

transitions.name: Reopen Issue
transitions.guard: The resolution failed or recurred.

transitions.name: Draft Version
transitions.guard: A new policy or procedure, or a new version of one, is drafted with its owner, policy domain and predecessor recorded.

transitions.name: Review Version
transitions.guard: The draft is reviewed against the policy it serves and the regulatory requirements.

transitions.name: Return Version for Rework
transitions.guard: The review returns the draft with findings.

transitions.name: Approve Policy Version
transitions.guard: The Data Governance Council approves the policy version.

transitions.name: Approve Procedure Version
transitions.guard: The Data Owner approves the procedure version.

transitions.name: Put Policy Version in Force
transitions.guard: The policy version is communicated and in force; its predecessor, if any, is superseded in the same act.

transitions.name: Put Procedure Version in Force
transitions.guard: The procedure version is communicated and in force; its predecessor, if any, is superseded in the same act.

transitions.name: Supersede Version
transitions.guard: Its successor has been put in force; recorded automatically in the same act, naming the successor.

transitions.name: Withdraw Policy Version
transitions.guard: The policy version in force is retired with no successor and the reason is recorded.

transitions.name: Withdraw Procedure Version
transitions.guard: The Data Owner retires the procedure version in force with no successor and records the reason (Howard, 24 Sep 2026, Open Decisions C3 option a).

transitions.name: Withdraw Approved Version
transitions.guard: An approved version is withdrawn before it goes in force.

transitions.name: Review Practices
transitions.guard: Current data-handling practices are reviewed against the preferred organisation ethics and the gaps recorded.

transitions.name: Identify Principles and Risk Factors
transitions.guard: Principles, preferred practices and risk factors are identified from the organisation ethics, regulations and business strategy.

transitions.name: Define Ethics Strategy
transitions.guard: The strategy, corporate statements and updated policies are drafted.

transitions.name: Approve Ethics Strategy
transitions.guard: The executives and governance bodies approve the strategy, statements and policies.

transitions.name: Return Strategy for Rework
transitions.guard: The strategy is rejected with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Bring Policies into Force
transitions.guard: The policies and corporate statements are published as governance instruments and the reporting and regulatory monitoring started.

transitions.name: Open Alignment Review
transitions.guard: A regulatory change, incident learnings or a business change is recorded; the policies in force are retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Realigned Strategy
transitions.guard: The realigned strategy, statements and policies are approved and published.

transitions.name: Retire Ethics Strategy
transitions.guard: No use is cleared under the strategy and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Identify Gap
transitions.guard: A gap between current and preferred practice is found by the practices review or an incident and logged as a Data Asset issue.

transitions.name: Plan Remediation
transitions.guard: The remediation is planned with an owner and date.

transitions.name: Address Gap
transitions.guard: The remediation (policy, practice, training or control) is executed.

transitions.name: Verify Closure
transitions.guard: The remediation is verified as effective and the gap closed.

transitions.name: Return Gap for Rework
transitions.guard: Verification fails with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Reopen Gap
transitions.guard: An incident or review shows the gap has recurred.

transitions.name: Accept Gap as Risk
transitions.guard: The gap is accepted as a risk with executive sign-off and recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Plan Communication
transitions.guard: The communication plan is drafted with its checklists and audiences from the strategy.

transitions.name: Develop Training
transitions.guard: The training programme is developed and the incentives, KPIs and targets aligned.

transitions.name: Launch Programme
transitions.guard: Training and communication start; affirmations and the number of employees trained are measured.

transitions.name: Return Training for Rework
transitions.guard: The training content is rejected with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Open Programme Refresh
transitions.guard: The annual refresh, a policy change or incident learnings trigger a refresh while training stays in operation.

transitions.name: Complete Programme Refresh
transitions.guard: The refreshed plan and training are in operation and affirmations renewed.

transitions.name: Retire Programme
transitions.guard: No use is cleared and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Assess Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The intended use is assessed against the principles and risk factors in force, citing the lawful basis of the asset.

transitions.name: Set Conditions
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Purpose limits, audience, sharing conditions, monitoring and reporting are set for the use.

transitions.name: Clear Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The governance body clears the use under its conditions while the training programme is in operation.

transitions.name: Decline Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The assessment fails; the use is declined with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Suspend Clearance
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A reported incident, a purpose change or a regulatory change suspends the clearance; the access-suspension trigger is emitted.

transitions.name: Restore Clearance
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The incident is closed or the change assessed and the conditions reconfirmed; no incident is open.

transitions.name: Withdraw Suspended Clearance
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The suspension is not resolved or the use ends; the clearance is withdrawn.

transitions.name: Withdraw Cleared Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The purpose is fulfilled or the basis for the use ends (consent withdrawn, contract ended).

transitions.name: Reassess Withdrawn Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A new purpose is proposed and assessed under the principles in force.

transitions.name: Reassess Declined Use
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The use is revised and reassessed.

transitions.name: Return Conditions
transitions.region: Ethical Use of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The governance body rejects the conditions; the use is reassessed.

transitions.name: Report Incident
transitions.guard: A breach or suspected breach of the handling conditions of an assessed use is reported and logged as a Data Asset issue; the access-suspension and assurance triggers are emitted.

transitions.name: Investigate Incident
transitions.guard: The facts, cause and scope are established.

transitions.name: Remediate Incident
transitions.guard: The confirmed breach is remediated and learnings passed to the strategy, gaps and programme.

transitions.name: Dismiss Incident
transitions.guard: The investigation does not confirm a breach; the incident is closed as dismissed with reasons.

transitions.name: Close Incident
transitions.guard: The remediation is verified and the reporting updated.

transitions.name: Reopen Incident
transitions.guard: New facts or a recurrence reopen the incident.

transitions.name: Return Remediation
transitions.guard: Verification of the remediation fails; the investigation is reopened.

transitions.name: Analyse Integration Requirements
transitions.guard: Business goals, data needs, regulatory requirements and the architectures are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Design DII Architecture
transitions.guard: Patterns, platforms and interface standards are designed within the data architecture in force.

transitions.name: Approve DII Architecture
transitions.guard: The architecture is approved and its interface standards approved as governing instruments.
transitions.holder: Data Integration and Interoperability Practice Manager

transitions.name: Return Architecture Design
transitions.guard: The design is rejected with recorded reasons.
transitions.holder: Data Integration and Interoperability Practice Manager

transitions.name: Bring DII Architecture into Force
transitions.guard: The platforms are in service and the standards published to the developers.

transitions.name: Open Architecture Revision
transitions.guard: A platform, pattern or regulatory trigger is recorded; the architecture in force is retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised DII Architecture
transitions.guard: The revised architecture is approved and its platforms in service.
transitions.holder: Data Integration and Interoperability Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire DII Architecture
transitions.guard: No exchange operates and no service is published under the architecture; the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Define Exchange Requirements
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A consumer or migration need for the asset is recorded with its format, timeframe, security and lifecycle requirements.

transitions.name: Profile Sources
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Source data is discovered and profiled and business rule compliance examined.

transitions.name: Map Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Sources are mapped to targets and the lineage documented in the metadata repository.

transitions.name: Orchestrate Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The orchestration, migration approach where applicable, event thresholds and DII metadata are developed under the architecture in force.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-05 Orchestration and Complex Event Processing Development

transitions.name: Agree Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Exchange Specification and Data Access Agreement are agreed for classified data with its privacy basis.

transitions.name: Return Exchange for Rework
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The agreement is rejected or withdrawn before acceptance.

transitions.name: Operate Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Implementation is accepted and monitoring against the thresholds active.

transitions.name: Raise Alert
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A threshold is breached; the alert is raised, a Data Asset issue logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Clear Alert
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The cause is resolved and the metrics are back within the thresholds.

transitions.name: Suspend Exchange on Alert
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: An unresolved alert requires the exchange to stop; the access-suspension trigger is emitted.

transitions.name: Suspend Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: An agreement lapse, security or regulatory cause stops the exchange.

transitions.name: Resume Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The suspension cause is resolved and the agreement is in force.

transitions.name: Retire Suspended Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The exchange is decommissioned; specification, agreement and lineage retained.

transitions.name: Retire Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The exchange completes its purpose (a migration finished, a consumer need ended) and is decommissioned.

transitions.name: Change Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A change to sources, targets or rules re-opens the mapping; the current exchange keeps running until the change is accepted.

transitions.name: Re-establish Exchange
transitions.region: Data Exchange of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A retired exchange is needed again and its requirements redefined.

transitions.name: Design Data Service
transitions.guard: The service is designed as a solution component to the architecture in force.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Develop Data Service
transitions.guard: The service is developed and tested against its contract.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Return Data Service for Rework
transitions.guard: Testing fails against the contract.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Publish Data Service
transitions.guard: The service is published in the catalogue and in operation.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Version Data Service
transitions.guard: A change request opens a new version; the current version stays published.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Release Service Version
transitions.guard: The new version is released and the previous version retained.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Deprecate Data Service
transitions.guard: A successor is named and consumers given a migration deadline.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Reinstate Data Service
transitions.guard: The deprecation is reversed.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Retire Data Service
transitions.guard: No consumer is bound and the service is withdrawn from the catalogue.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Redesign Data Service
transitions.guard: A retired service is needed again and redesigned.
mechanisms: CTRL-DII-08 Data Service Development and Publication

transitions.name: Plan Modelling
transitions.guard: Data standards, the data architecture, patterns and industry models are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Standards
transitions.guard: The modelling standards and plan are approved and the standards approved as governing instruments under Data Governance.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Bring Standards into Force
transitions.guard: The standards are published to the modelling tools and review checklists.

transitions.name: Open Standards Revision
transitions.guard: A tool, architecture or pattern trigger is recorded; the standards in force are retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Standards
transitions.guard: The revised standards and plan are approved.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Standards
transitions.guard: The standards are retired without replacement and the retirement recorded.

transitions.name: Draft Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: The conceptual model is built to the standards in force from the requirements and the enterprise data model.

transitions.name: Review Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: The conceptual model is reviewed against the standards and the requirements and the enterprise data model; the validation measurement is recorded.

transitions.name: Return Conceptual Data Model for Rework
transitions.guard: The review findings require rework before approval; a Data Asset issue is logged with Data Governance.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: The review findings are closed and the model version approved.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Publish Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: The approved version is published as the current version in the modelling tool and metadata repository with its lineage.

transitions.name: Open Conceptual Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: A change request opens a new version in draft; the current version stays managed.

transitions.name: Review Conceptual Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: The revised version is reviewed against the standards and its differences from the current version recorded.

transitions.name: Supersede Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: The asset is disposed or descoped, or the model is replaced by another managed model; the model is withdrawn and retained.

transitions.name: Re-model Conceptual Data Model
transitions.guard: A superseded model is needed again and re-drafted from its retained version.

transitions.name: Draft Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: The logical model is built to the standards in force from the approved conceptual model.

transitions.name: Review Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: The logical model is reviewed against the standards and the approved conceptual model; the validation measurement is recorded.

transitions.name: Return Logical Data Model for Rework
transitions.guard: The review findings require rework before approval; a Data Asset issue is logged with Data Governance.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: The review findings are closed and the model version approved.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Publish Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: The approved version is published as the current version in the modelling tool and metadata repository with its lineage.

transitions.name: Open Logical Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: A change request opens a new version in draft; the current version stays managed.

transitions.name: Review Logical Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: The revised version is reviewed against the standards and its differences from the current version recorded.

transitions.name: Supersede Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: The asset is disposed or descoped, or the model is replaced by another managed model; the model is withdrawn and retained.

transitions.name: Re-model Logical Data Model
transitions.guard: A superseded model is needed again and re-drafted from its retained version.

transitions.name: Draft Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The physical model is built to the standards in force from the approved logical model and the selected database type.

transitions.name: Review Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The physical model is reviewed against the standards and the approved logical model and the selected database type; the validation measurement is recorded.

transitions.name: Return Physical Data Model for Rework
transitions.guard: The review findings require rework before approval; a Data Asset issue is logged with Data Governance.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The review findings are closed and the model version approved.
transitions.holder: Data Modelling and Design Practice Manager

transitions.name: Publish Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The approved version is published as the current version in the modelling tool and metadata repository with its lineage.

transitions.name: Open Physical Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: A change request opens a new version in draft; the current version stays deployed.

transitions.name: Review Physical Data Model Revision
transitions.guard: The revised version is reviewed against the standards and its differences from the current version recorded.

transitions.name: Supersede Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The asset is disposed or descoped, or the model is replaced by another managed model; the model is withdrawn and retained.

transitions.name: Re-model Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: A superseded model is needed again and re-drafted from its retained version.

transitions.name: Deploy Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: The managed physical model is implemented as the schema of the store and the deployment verified against the managed version.

transitions.name: Withdraw Undeployed Physical Data Model
transitions.guard: A managed physical model that was never deployed is withdrawn and retained.

transitions.name: Define Programme
transitions.guard: A sponsor exists; data policies and standards and consumer requirements are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Programme
transitions.guard: Strategy and framework, programme organisation and DQ policies and guidelines are approved.

transitions.name: Operate Programme
transitions.guard: Programme roles are staffed, DQM procedures are in force and reporting is in place.

transitions.name: Revise Programme
transitions.guard: A strategic, regulatory or performance trigger is recorded; procedures in force are retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Programme
transitions.guard: The revised strategy, framework or organisation is approved.

transitions.name: Retire Programme
transitions.guard: The programme is retired without replacement and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Define Expectation
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Asset is in the programme's scope and a Data Owner and Steward are assigned.

transitions.name: Approve Expectation and Assess
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Critical data, rules, thresholds and service level are approved and the assessment scope is set.

transitions.name: Confirm Conforming Quality
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Measured results meet the expectation and service level; monitoring is deployed.

transitions.name: Record Non-conformance
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Measured results breach the expectation; issues are identified, prioritised and logged with Data Governance.

transitions.name: Plan Improvement
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Root causes are analysed and actions are prioritised by business impact and confirmed.

transitions.name: Execute Remediation
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Confirmed actions are resourced and authorised.

transitions.name: Verify Remediation
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Actions are complete and the Data Asset is reassessed against the expectation.

transitions.name: Detect Non-conformance
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Monitoring shows a breach of threshold or service level.

transitions.name: Lapse Assessment
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The measurement validity interval has elapsed or the expectation, data or process has changed.

transitions.name: Reassess
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Reassessment scope is authorised against the expectation in force.

transitions.name: Revise Expectation after Non-conformance
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Owner revises the expectation (with Data Governance risk acceptance where a threshold is relaxed).

transitions.name: Revise Expectation after Lapse
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The expectation is revised before reassessment.

transitions.name: Withdraw from Quality Scope
transitions.region: Quality PDCA Cycle for a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Asset leaves the programme's scope (for example on disposition) and the withdrawal is recorded.

transitions.name: Identify Requirements
transitions.guard: Business goals, rules, regulatory requirements, architecture standards and the enterprise data model are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Policy and Standards
transitions.guard: Policy, privacy and confidentiality standards and security architecture are approved against the identified requirements.

transitions.name: Publish Instruments
transitions.guard: Instruments are published as governing instruments with Data Governance and audit is scheduled.

transitions.name: Review Instruments
transitions.guard: A regulatory, incident or business trigger is recorded; current versions stay in force.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Instruments
transitions.guard: Revised instruments are approved.

transitions.name: Retire Instruments
transitions.guard: All security instruments for the scope are retired without replacement and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Assess Classification
transitions.region: Security Classification of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The asset is in scope and standards in force define the classification scheme.

transitions.name: Classify Asset
transitions.region: Security Classification of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Confidentiality, regulatory and privacy categories are decided and recorded as a security attribute in the metadata.

transitions.name: Trigger Reclassification
transitions.region: Security Classification of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Content, use, regulation or standards have changed.

transitions.name: Reclassify Asset
transitions.region: Security Classification of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The reassessed classification is decided and recorded; protection is re-evaluated.

transitions.name: Declassify Asset
transitions.region: Security Classification of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The asset leaves the scope (for example after destruction) and its classification is retired.

transitions.name: Assess Security Risk
transitions.guard: The asset is classified and the standards in force specify the controls per class.

transitions.name: Confirm Protection
transitions.guard: Every required control is implemented, tested and audited; residual risk accepted.

transitions.name: Declare Deficiency
transitions.guard: An audit, incident or change shows a required control missing or ineffective.

transitions.name: Remediate Deficiency
transitions.guard: The deficient control is remediated and verified.

transitions.name: Reassess after Classification Change
transitions.guard: The classification changed, so the required controls must be re-specified.

transitions.name: Sanitise Asset
transitions.guard: Destruction is authorised; content is sanitised or securely destroyed and keys revoked.

transitions.name: Sanitise Deficient Asset
transitions.guard: Destruction is authorised while a deficiency is open; sanitisation is evidenced.

transitions.name: Release Sanitised Record
transitions.guard: Sanitisation evidence is retained and the protection record closed.

transitions.name: Identify Personal Data
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The classification records a privacy category other than none.

transitions.name: Record Lawful Basis
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Lawful basis, purpose and retention are recorded and consent obtained where required.

transitions.name: Receive Subject Request
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A data subject request is received and logged with its statutory deadline.

transitions.name: Answer Subject Request
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The request is answered within the statutory period and the basis remains in force.

transitions.name: Lapse Basis
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Consent is withdrawn, the purpose is fulfilled or the retention period has expired.

transitions.name: Lapse Basis on Erasure Request
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: An erasure or objection request is upheld.

transitions.name: Re-establish Basis
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A new lawful basis or renewed consent is sought before any further processing.

transitions.name: Remove Personal Data
transitions.region: Privacy Basis of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Personal data is destroyed or anonymised and the removal evidenced.

transitions.name: Detect Incident
transitions.guard: An incident is detected and logged; access to the asset is suspended and a DG issue logged.

transitions.name: Contain Incident
transitions.guard: Cause contained and impact assessed.

transitions.name: Notify Regulator and Subjects
transitions.guard: The impact assessment requires notification; notifications are sent within the statutory period.

transitions.name: Close Notified Incident
transitions.guard: Root cause addressed, controls remediated, review completed.

transitions.name: Close Contained Incident
transitions.guard: No notification required; root cause addressed and review completed.

transitions.name: Archive Incident
transitions.guard: Closure evidence retained; the DG issue is resolved.

transitions.name: Reopen Incident
transitions.guard: The incident recurs or new impact is found.

transitions.name: Understand Technology
transitions.guard: A technology requirement arises from the data architecture or data requirements.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Evaluate Technology
transitions.guard: The technology is evaluated against the evaluation criteria.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Adopt Technology
transitions.guard: The evaluation supports adoption and the decision is recorded.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Reject Technology
transitions.guard: The evaluation does not support adoption.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Monitor Technology
transitions.guard: The first environment on the technology is in service; monitoring starts.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Re-evaluate Technology
transitions.guard: A version, licence, capacity or architecture trigger requires re-evaluation; environments keep running.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Technology
transitions.guard: No environment runs on the technology and the retirement is recorded.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Reconsider Retired Technology
transitions.guard: A new requirement reopens a retired technology.
transitions.holder: Data Storage and Operations Practice Manager

transitions.name: Understand Environment Requirements
transitions.guard: Architecture, models, service levels and naming standards for the environment are agreed.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Develop Environment
transitions.guard: The instance is developed on an adopted technology by scripted change along the change implementation path.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Accept into Service
transitions.guard: The environment meets its OLA in acceptance testing and monitoring is active.

transitions.name: Return Environment for Rework
transitions.guard: Acceptance fails with recorded reasons.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Declare Degradation
transitions.guard: Monitoring detects an OLA breach; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Restore Service
transitions.guard: Tuning or repair returns the environment within its OLA.

transitions.name: Decommission Environment
transitions.guard: All stored instances are purged or migrated and the decommission recorded.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Decommission Degraded Environment
transitions.guard: A degraded environment is replaced; its instances are migrated or purged first.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Rebuild Environment
transitions.guard: A decommissioned environment is required again and its requirements re-agreed.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Load Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The asset's data is loaded into an environment in service under the deployed physical model and a protected classification.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Protect Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A backup is taken and verified within the OLA recovery point and time.

transitions.name: Lose Protection
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A backup fails verification or falls outside the recovery point.

transitions.name: Archive Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: An archive copy is taken and verified and the instance withdrawn from active use.

transitions.name: Restore Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The instance is restored from the archive copy and re-protected.

transitions.name: Start Migration
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A migration, replication or versioning plan is approved; the source stays protected.

transitions.name: Complete Migration
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Source and target are reconciled and the target protected; cut-over recorded.

transitions.name: Roll Back Migration
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The migration is abandoned; the source is re-verified before protection is confirmed again.

transitions.name: Purge Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The sanitised instance and its backups are purged and the purge confirmed.

transitions.name: Purge Archived Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The archive copy reaches the end of its retention and is purged with confirmation.

transitions.name: Reload Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A new instance of a previously purged asset is loaded (reinstated asset).
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-02 Environment Development and Change Implementation

transitions.name: Replicate Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Replication to a second environment is activated and the replica verified within the OLA lag.

transitions.name: Cease Replication
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Replication is withdrawn; the primary stays protected.

transitions.name: Start Migration of Replicated Instance
transitions.region: Stored Instance of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A migration or versioning plan is approved for a replicated instance; replication is folded into the migration.

transitions.name: Request Test Dataset
transitions.guard: The testing team's request names the source instance, subset and refresh interval.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Provision Test Dataset
transitions.guard: The dataset is copied or subset from a protected or replicated stored instance into a test environment.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Reject Test Data Request
transitions.guard: The request is rejected with recorded reasons.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Mask Test Dataset
transitions.guard: De-identification to the asset's security classification is applied and verified.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Flag Refresh Due
transitions.guard: The source instance or its model changed beyond the refresh interval.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Refresh Test Dataset
transitions.guard: The dataset is re-provisioned from the source and awaits re-masking.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Retire Test Dataset
transitions.guard: The dataset is withdrawn and purged from the test environment.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Retire Stale Test Dataset
transitions.guard: A stale dataset is withdrawn instead of refreshed and purged.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Re-request Test Dataset
transitions.guard: A retired dataset is requested again.
mechanisms: CTRL-DSO-08 Test Dataset Provisioning and Masking

transitions.name: Plan Continuity
transitions.guard: Recovery objectives are drawn from the service level agreements and the plan drafted.

transitions.name: Test Plan
transitions.guard: A recovery test meets the recovery objectives.

transitions.name: Fail Test
transitions.guard: A scheduled test misses the recovery objectives; the plan is out of force until retested.

transitions.name: Invoke Plan
transitions.guard: A continuity event (loss, corruption, outage) invokes the plan; the assurance trigger is emitted.

transitions.name: Recover Operations
transitions.guard: Recovery is confirmed against the recovery objectives.

transitions.name: Stand Down Plan
transitions.guard: The post-incident review confirms the plan stands.

transitions.name: Revise Plan after Recovery
transitions.guard: The post-incident review requires plan changes; the plan is retested.

transitions.name: Revise Plan
transitions.guard: An environment, technology or service-level change requires plan revision and retest.

transitions.name: Retire Plan
transitions.guard: The environment is decommissioned and its plan retired.

transitions.name: Understand DW Requirements
transitions.guard: Business, scalability, quality, security and access requirements and the IT strategy are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Define DW and BI Architecture
transitions.guard: Subject areas, layers, platform standards, the population process pattern and governance activities are defined within the data architecture in force.

transitions.name: Approve DW and BI Architecture
transitions.to: DW and BI Architecture in Force
transitions.guard: The architecture is approved by the governance body and sponsors.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Return Architecture Definition
transitions.guard: The definition is rejected with recorded reasons.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Open Architecture Maintenance
transitions.from: DW and BI Architecture in Force
transitions.guard: A requirement, platform or strategy trigger is recorded; the architecture in force is retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Maintained Architecture
transitions.to: DW and BI Architecture in Force
transitions.guard: The maintained architecture is approved.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire DW and BI Architecture
transitions.guard: No store is in production under the architecture and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Require Warehouse
transitions.guard: The store's subject areas and requirements are agreed under the architecture.

transitions.name: Develop Warehouse
transitions.guard: The store is developed in an environment in service and accepted against its requirements.

transitions.name: Release Warehouse to Production
transitions.guard: The production support process is in place and monitoring active.

transitions.name: Return Warehouse for Rework
transitions.guard: Acceptance fails with recorded reasons.

transitions.name: Open Load Tuning
transitions.guard: A response, performance or support breach is detected; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Complete Tuning
transitions.guard: Load tuning returns the store within its targets.

transitions.name: Retire Warehouse
transitions.guard: All populations and products are retired or migrated and the decommission recorded.

transitions.name: Retire Warehouse under Tuning
transitions.guard: A store that cannot be tuned to target is replaced; populations and products migrated or retired first.

transitions.name: Rebuild Warehouse
transitions.guard: A retired store is required again and its requirements re-agreed.

transitions.name: Design Population Process
transitions.guard: The source feed, transformations, schedule and reconciliation rules are designed for the asset under the architecture.

transitions.name: Load Asset
transitions.guard: The population process runs into a store in production over the asset's exchange.

transitions.name: Reconcile Load
transitions.guard: The load balances to source, audit data is retained and the lineage recorded in the dictionary.

transitions.name: Fail Load
transitions.guard: The load run fails or does not reconcile; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Remediate Load
transitions.guard: The cause is remediated and the load rerun.

transitions.name: Run Refresh
transitions.guard: A scheduled or requested refresh run loads new data; the current reconciled population stays in use.

transitions.name: Reconcile Refresh
transitions.guard: The refresh reconciles and supersedes the previous population; lineage updated.

transitions.name: Fail Refresh
transitions.guard: The refresh fails; the previous reconciled population stays available and an issue is logged.

transitions.name: Retire Population
transitions.guard: The asset is withdrawn from the warehouse with no product depending on it; audit data and lineage retained.

transitions.name: Retire Failed Population
transitions.guard: A failed population is withdrawn instead of remediated.

transitions.name: Re-populate Asset
transitions.guard: A retired population is needed again and its process redesigned.

transitions.name: Specify Data Product
transitions.guard: The product is specified with the product owner from the requirements, using prototypes.
mechanisms: CTRL-DWBI-06 Data Product Specification and Build

transitions.name: Build Data Product
transitions.guard: The product is built on reconciled populations and tested against its specification.
mechanisms: CTRL-DWBI-06 Data Product Specification and Build

transitions.name: Return Product for Rework
transitions.guard: Testing fails against the specification.
mechanisms: CTRL-DWBI-06 Data Product Specification and Build

transitions.name: Release Data Product
transitions.guard: The product is released under the release plan with its lineage in the dictionary and learning material available.

transitions.name: Confirm Adoption
transitions.guard: Usage and satisfaction metrics meet the adoption plan.

transitions.name: Raise Usage Alert
transitions.guard: BI activity monitoring flags a usage or satisfaction shortfall; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance trigger emitted.

transitions.name: Raise Data Alert
transitions.guard: BI activity monitoring flags a data or performance issue; a Data Asset issue is logged and the assurance and access-suspension triggers emitted.

transitions.name: Resolve Data Alert
transitions.guard: The data or performance cause is resolved and the product verified.

transitions.name: Retire Product on Data Alert
transitions.guard: An unresolved data alert leads to withdrawal under the release plan.

transitions.name: Resolve Usage Alert
transitions.guard: The cause is resolved and the metrics recover.

transitions.name: Change Data Product
transitions.guard: A change request re-opens the specification; the released product stays available until the new version is released.
mechanisms: CTRL-DWBI-06 Data Product Specification and Build

transitions.name: Retire Data Product
transitions.guard: The product is withdrawn under the release plan and consumers redirected.

transitions.name: Retire Product on Usage Alert
transitions.guard: An unresolved usage alert leads to withdrawal under the release plan.

transitions.name: Retire Unadopted Product
transitions.guard: A released product that is not adopted is withdrawn under the release plan.

transitions.name: Respecify Retired Product
transitions.guard: A retired product is requested again and respecified.
mechanisms: CTRL-DWBI-06 Data Product Specification and Build

transitions.name: Plan BI Portfolio
transitions.guard: The learning and adoption plan and release plan are drafted from the specified products.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve BI Portfolio
transitions.guard: The sponsors and product owner approve the plans.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Return Portfolio Plans
transitions.guard: The plans are rejected with recorded reasons.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Activate BI Portfolio
transitions.guard: The release plan is in force and BI activity monitoring active.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Open Portfolio Review
transitions.guard: Usage, satisfaction or strategy findings trigger a review; the release plan in force is retained meanwhile.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Reviewed Portfolio
transitions.guard: The reviewed plans are approved and in operation.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire BI Portfolio
transitions.guard: No product is released under the plans and the retirement is recorded.
transitions.holder: Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence Practice Manager

transitions.name: Plan Records Management
transitions.guard: The legal retention requirements and the business and IT strategies are available; record classes, the retention schedule and e-discovery obligations are drafted.

transitions.name: Develop Content Strategy
transitions.guard: The content strategy and the handling policies, including the e-discovery approach, are drafted from the records management plan.

transitions.name: Approve Strategy and Policies
transitions.guard: The legal and business teams approve the strategy, policies and retention schedule.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Return Strategy for Rework
transitions.guard: The strategy or policies are rejected with recorded reasons.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Bring Policies into Force
transitions.guard: The policies and procedures are published and the retention schedule brought into force; the compliance audit metric is defined.

transitions.name: Open Strategy Review
transitions.guard: An audit finding, a legal change or a strategy trigger is recorded; a Data Asset issue is logged for an audit finding; the policies in force are retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Reviewed Strategy
transitions.guard: The reviewed strategy and policies are approved and published.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Strategy
transitions.guard: No item is under management and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Define Information Architecture
transitions.guard: The taxonomy, controlled vocabulary, tagging scheme, markup and exchange formats and repository design are defined within the enterprise data architecture in force.

transitions.name: Approve Information Architecture
transitions.guard: The information architecture is approved.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Withdraw Definition
transitions.guard: The definition is rejected with recorded reasons and withdrawn; a new definition follows.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Bring Repository into Service
transitions.guard: The content repository is implemented in an environment in service, the taxonomy loaded and tagging enforced on capture.

transitions.name: Open Architecture Change
transitions.guard: A taxonomy change or repository migration is recorded; the architecture in force and the repository stay in service.

transitions.name: Approve Architecture Change
transitions.guard: The changed architecture is approved and every item re-tagged or migrated without loss.
transitions.holder: Document and Content Management Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Information Architecture
transitions.guard: No item is held in the repository and the decommission is recorded.

transitions.name: Capture Content
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The item is captured into the repository in service in its medium with its capture metadata, under the policies in force.

transitions.name: Classify Content
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The record class, retention category, security classification and access level are assigned and the tags completed under the taxonomy and the handling policy.

transitions.name: Publish Content
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The item is published and delivered to its audience through the repository or a delivery channel under the handling policy and its access level.

transitions.name: Withdraw Content
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The published item is withdrawn from its audience; the classified item remains.

transitions.name: Declare Record
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The classified item is declared a record under the retention schedule in force; it is locked against change and its retention period starts.

transitions.name: Declare Published Record
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The published item is declared a record; it stays retrievable to its audience but is locked against change.

transitions.name: Archive Record
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The record moves to archive storage under preservation controls with its integrity evidenced; retention continues.

transitions.name: Retrieve Archived Record
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: An entitled request restores the record to active management.

transitions.name: Expire Retention
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The retention period of the declared record ends; disposition becomes due.

transitions.name: Expire Archived Retention
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: The retention period of the archived record ends; disposition becomes due.

transitions.name: Dispose of Record
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: No hold is active over the record, disposition is authorised under the disposition rule, and the disposition certificate and audit log are retained.

transitions.name: Extend Retention
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: A new legal, regulatory or business obligation extends the retention period under the policies in force.

transitions.name: Discard Content
transitions.region: Record or Content Item of a Data Asset
transitions.guard: Classified content that is not declared a record is discarded under the handling policy; no hold is active over it; the audit log is retained.

transitions.name: Identify Hold
transitions.guard: The legal team identifies a litigation, regulatory, contractual or investigation matter and defines its scope under the e-discovery approach.

transitions.name: Issue Preservation Notice
transitions.guard: The preservation notice is issued to the custodians and acknowledged; disposition of every item in scope is suspended; the assurance trigger is emitted.

transitions.name: Withdraw Identified Hold
transitions.guard: The legal team determines that no hold is required and records the reason.

transitions.name: Start Discovery
transitions.guard: A collection, review or production request is received; the hold stays active.

transitions.name: Complete Discovery
transitions.guard: The production is delivered and the collection set recorded; the hold stays active.

transitions.name: Release Hold
transitions.guard: The matter is concluded and the legal team releases the hold; disposition resumes under the retention schedule.

transitions.name: Release Hold after Discovery
transitions.guard: The matter concludes during discovery and the legal team releases the hold with the production record retained.

transitions.name: Close Hold Record
transitions.guard: The hold record is closed and retained; the matter no longer constrains disposition.

transitions.name: Reinstate Hold
transitions.guard: The matter is reopened and the preservation notice reissued.

GDA-GLOBAL-PROTOCOL.name: Global Data Asset Architecture: Formal Data Asset Protocol (Global FTS)

transitions.name: Register Asset
transitions.guard: Proposal identity, purpose and sponsor are sufficient; registration control passes.

transitions.name: Materialize Asset
transitions.guard: Authorized representation exists; custody and minimum controls are established.

transitions.name: Supersede Asset
transitions.guard: Successor is identified; residual use and retention requirements are decided.

transitions.name: Reinstate Asset
transitions.guard: Supersession decision is revoked; asset remains intact and use conditions are reassessed.

transitions.name: Destroy Materialized Asset
transitions.guard: Disposition is due; no active hold; custody is controlled; destruction authorization granted.

transitions.name: Destroy Superseded Asset
transitions.guard: Disposition is due; no active hold; successor traceability is retained; authorization granted.

transitions.name: Initiate Assessment
transitions.guard: Assurance criteria, scope, assessor and evidence request are defined.

transitions.name: Confirm Assurance
transitions.guard: Required criteria pass and evidence is sufficient, current and attributable.

transitions.name: Grant Conditional Assurance
transitions.guard: Residual limitations are acceptable; conditions, monitoring and expiry are authorized.

transitions.name: Record Assurance Deficiency
transitions.guard: One or more material criteria fail or evidence is insufficient.

transitions.name: Suspend Assurance
transitions.guard: Material change, control failure or evidence invalidation affects the assurance claim.

transitions.name: Suspend Conditional Assurance
transitions.guard: Condition breached, expired or no longer monitored.

transitions.name: Reassess Deficiency
transitions.guard: Remediation is declared ready and reassessment scope is approved.

transitions.name: Reassess Suspension
transitions.guard: Suspension cause is addressed and reassessment is authorized.

transitions.name: Expire Assurance
transitions.guard: Assurance validity has expired without completed reassessment.

transitions.name: Expire Conditional Assurance
transitions.guard: Conditional assurance validity has expired without renewal.

transitions.name: Release Access
transitions.guard: Purpose, entitlement, assurance, risk and controls satisfy the release policy.

transitions.name: Restrict Access
transitions.guard: A valid restriction decision or changed classification requires limited access.

transitions.name: Suspend Access
transitions.guard: A credible control failure, risk trigger or incident requires immediate temporary suspension.

transitions.name: Restore Access
transitions.guard: Suspension cause is resolved; controls and assurance are current; restoration is authorized.

transitions.name: Withdraw Access
transitions.guard: Authorized use has ended or withdrawal obligation applies.

transitions.name: Withdraw Suspended Access
transitions.guard: Suspension review determines that access must end.

transitions.name: Reconsider Withdrawal
transitions.guard: A new legitimate purpose exists and re-entry review is authorized.

transitions.name: Grant Emergency Access
transitions.guard: Emergency basis, scope, monitoring, approver and expiry are recorded.

transitions.name: Close Emergency Access
transitions.guard: Emergency purpose is complete or authorization expires; activity is reviewed.

transitions.name: Withdraw Restricted Access
transitions.guard: Withdrawal obligation applies to an asset that was never released; residual access basis is recorded.

transitions.name: Establish Active Custody
transitions.guard: Custodian accepts accountability; location and protection controls are active.

transitions.name: Enter Preservation Custody
transitions.guard: Preservation criteria, package, retention basis and integrity controls are satisfied.

transitions.name: Restore Active Custody
transitions.guard: Active management need exists; integrity and use controls are reassessed.

transitions.name: Place in External Custody
transitions.guard: External arrangement, accountability, protection and oversight are approved.

transitions.name: Initiate Custody Transfer
transitions.guard: Recipient, authority, transfer package and chain-of-custody plan are approved.

transitions.name: Initiate Preserved Transfer
transitions.guard: Recipient, preservation obligations and transfer package are approved.

transitions.name: Complete External Transfer
transitions.guard: Recipient receipt and acceptance are evidenced; obligations are transferred or retained explicitly.

transitions.name: Cancel Custody Transfer
transitions.guard: Transfer is cancelled before acceptance and source custody remains intact.

transitions.name: Close Custody after Transfer
transitions.guard: Local custodial responsibility has ended and closure evidence is complete.

transitions.name: Close Custody after Destruction
transitions.guard: Existence is Destruction and destruction evidence is complete.

transitions.name: Define Strategy
transitions.guard: A sponsor exists; business requirements, data architecture and metadata issues are available as inputs.

transitions.name: Approve Strategy and Requirements
transitions.guard: The strategy and the business and technical requirements it serves are approved.

transitions.name: Operate Programme
transitions.guard: Programme roles are staffed and coverage, contribution and usage reporting is in place.

transitions.name: Revise Programme
transitions.guard: A business, architectural or regulatory trigger is recorded; the programme in force is retained meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Strategy
transitions.guard: The revised strategy or requirements are approved.

transitions.name: Retire Programme
transitions.guard: The programme is retired without replacement and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Design Architecture
transitions.guard: An approved programme and data architecture inputs exist.

transitions.name: Approve Architecture
transitions.guard: The metamodel, standards and store design are approved.

transitions.name: Activate Stores
