transitions.guard: Repositories are in service, integration runs and the metadata control process is in force.

transitions.name: Revise Architecture
transitions.guard: A metamodel, standards or store change is required; stores stay in service meanwhile.

transitions.name: Approve Revised Architecture
transitions.guard: The revised metamodel, standards or store design is approved.

transitions.name: Retire Architecture
transitions.guard: Stores are decommissioned with their metadata archived and the retirement is recorded.

transitions.name: Scope Metadata Requirements
transitions.guard: The Data Asset is in the programme's scope and a steward is assigned.

transitions.name: Describe Asset
transitions.guard: Metadata is created and integrated in an operating store against the metamodel; lineage and dependencies are captured.

transitions.name: Publish Metadata
transitions.guard: The description is accepted and delivered through the standard access path.

transitions.name: Flag Stale Metadata
transitions.guard: A source, structure, process or rule change is detected by the control process or reported as a metadata issue.

transitions.name: Refresh Metadata
transitions.guard: The description is re-integrated and lineage re-verified.

transitions.name: Withdraw Publication
transitions.guard: Publication is withdrawn (for example on access withdrawal) while the description is retained.

transitions.name: Flag Described Asset Stale
transitions.guard: A change invalidates a description that is not yet published.

transitions.name: Archive Metadata after Destruction
transitions.guard: The Data Asset is destroyed or its custody closed; the description is retained and publication ends.

transitions.name: Archive Described Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Asset is destroyed or its custody closed before publication.

transitions.name: Archive Stale Asset
transitions.guard: The Data Asset is destroyed or its custody closed while its description is stale.

transitions.name: Identify Requirements
transitions.guard: Business drivers, cross-functional requirements, industry standards and the glossary are available as inputs.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Approach and Policies
transitions.guard: The architectural approach, stewardship and maintenance processes and governance policies are approved.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager

transitions.name: Activate Sharing Architecture
transitions.guard: The data sharing and integration architecture is in service and reusable data services are offered.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Revise Programme
transitions.guard: A business, architectural or regulatory trigger is recorded; the programme in force is retained meanwhile.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager

transitions.name: Approve Revised Approach
transitions.guard: The revised approach, processes or policies are approved.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager

transitions.name: Retire Programme
transitions.guard: The programme is retired without replacement and the retirement is recorded.
transitions.holder: Reference and Master Data Practice Manager

transitions.name: Validate Domain Definitions
transitions.guard: The domain is in the programme's scope; definitions are validated against the glossary and requirements.

transitions.name: Assess Domain Sources
transitions.guard: Candidate sources are evaluated and a system of record or reference is designated.

transitions.name: Model Domain
transitions.guard: The domain data model and integration pattern are approved under the programme's approach.

transitions.name: Define Domain Stewardship
transitions.guard: Stewards are assigned and maintenance processes and policies defined for the domain.

transitions.name: Publish Sharing Service
transitions.guard: The sharing and integration service is implemented, sources acquired and conditions-of-use agreements in place.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Open Domain Change
transitions.guard: A definition, model or service change is requested; the current service stays in service.

transitions.name: Approve Domain Change
transitions.guard: The change is approved and deployed to the sharing service.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Withdraw Domain
transitions.guard: The domain leaves the programme's scope; its sharing service is decommissioned and its records retired.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Validate Set
transitions.guard: A source (industry standard, purchased, open or internal) is assessed and definitions and mappings validated.

transitions.name: Publish Version
transitions.guard: The validated version is published through the sharing service under conditions of use.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Validate New Version
transitions.guard: An industry update or internal change is validated as a new version; the current version stays published.

transitions.name: Supersede Version
transitions.guard: The new version is published and the previous version retained for historical resolution.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Retire Set
transitions.guard: The set is withdrawn from sharing with no consumer dependency outstanding.
mechanisms: CTRL-RMD-06 Data Sharing and Integration Service

transitions.name: Reinstate Set
transitions.guard: A retired set is needed again and re-validated.

transitions.name: Match Record
transitions.guard: The candidate is matched by the domain's match rules and merged or created; survivorship applied.

transitions.name: Confirm Reliable Record
transitions.guard: The record is reconciled across sources, quality-assessed as conforming and published.

transitions.name: Detect Conflict
transitions.guard: A match conflict, survivorship dispute or quality non-conformance is detected and a DG issue logged.

transitions.name: Detect Conflict on Match
transitions.guard: The match result is disputed before confirmation.

transitions.name: Resolve Conflict
transitions.guard: The conflict is resolved (survivorship decided, quality remediated) and the record re-matched.

transitions.name: Split Record
transitions.guard: The conflict shows a false merge; the record is split into separate entities.

transitions.name: Re-match after Split
transitions.guard: Each split part is re-matched and merged or created.

transitions.name: Update Reliable Record
transitions.guard: A source update requires re-matching and survivorship; the published record stays available until reconfirmed.

transitions.name: Retire Record
transitions.guard: The entity instance ends or is merged into another record; the record is withdrawn from sharing and retained.

transitions.name: Retire Conflicted Record
transitions.guard: The conflict is resolved by retiring the record (duplicate merged elsewhere).

transitions.name: Reactivate Record
transitions.guard: A retired entity returns (for example a re-onboarded customer) and is treated as a new candidate with its history.
